 Hulu Drops Trailer for Reimagined "The Circle," Where Audience Votes Now Shape the Game 
 The revived competition series puts audience votes at the center as players compete for popularity behind ever-changing identities. 
 by 
 Luke Manning 
 | 
 Nov 10, 2026 11:35am (Pacific) 
 Tags: The Circle , Reality TV , Hulu , Disney TV 
 Hulu has dropped the trailer for their reimagined version of the social experiment series  The Circle .
 What's Happening: 
 Earlier this year, we learned that  Hulu picked up  The Circle , reviving the social experiment competition series after Netflix did not renew it following Season 7 in October 2024.
 Reimagined as a fast-turnaround social experiment, Hulu’s  The Circle  brings together everyday players and celebrities to compete side by side in a game of popularity where identity is ever-changing, and anyone can be anyone.
 Filmed in real time, the series gives viewers exclusive access as twists and player ratings unfold, with audience votes shaping the game for the first time.
 Contestants will continue to live in separate apartments and communicate only through a dedicated app, where they can compete as themselves or adopt a fake identity.
 The updated series will be hosted by Christina Najjar, better known as Tinx, a New York Times bestselling author, creator and host of  It’s Me, Tinx  on SiriusXM.
 The Circle  will debut on Hulu on  Tuesday, November 17  with three new episodes weekly, airing Tuesday through Thursday for five weeks, culminating in the season finale on  Friday, December 18 .
 More Hulu News: 
 The new Tony McNamara series Mosquito , starring Nicholas Hoult and Daisy Edgar-Jones, is finally moving forward .
 The voice cast of Frozen – Kristen Bell, Idina Menzel, Jonathan Groff and Josh Gad – will be reprising their roles for a new natural history series from National Geographic.
 Hulu will shine a light on Grammy Award-winning musician Darius Rucker in their new documentary,  Darius Rucker: They Called Me Hootie .
 Disney+  and Hulu's new romantic epic,  The Remarried Empress , has become the  most viewed local original premiere  of all time on both platforms globally.
